question: A cottage industry manufactures two types of products: chairs and tables. Both products are processed on three machines: A, B, and C. Each chair requires 2 hours on machine A, 1 hour on B, and 1 hour on C. Each table requires 1 hour on A, 1 hour on B, and 3 hours on C. The maximum time available per week on machine A is 20 hours, on B is 15 hours, and on C is 30 hours. If the profit per chair is ₹50 and per table is ₹80, formulate the LPP to maximize profit and find the optimal production mix using the graphical method. Also, determine if there is any alternative optimal solution.
explanation:
Let $x =$ number of chairs, $y =$ number of tables.

Objective: Maximize $Z = 50x + 80y$

Subject to:
$2x + y \leq 20$ (A)
$x + y \leq 15$ (B)
$x + 3y \leq 30$ (C)
$x \geq 0$, $y \geq 0$

Find corner points:
(1) $2x + y = 20$ (i)
(2) $x + y = 15$ (ii)
(3) $x + 3y = 30$ (iii)

Intersection (i) & (ii):
$2x + y = 20$, $x + y = 15$
Subtract:
$x = 5; y = 10$

Intersection (ii) & (iii):
$x + y = 15$, $x + 3y = 30$
Subtract:
$2y = 15 \implies y = 7.5$
$x = 15 - 7.5 = 7.5$

Intersection (i) & (iii):
$2x + y = 20$, $x + 3y = 30$
From (i): $y = 20 - 2x$
Substitute in (iii): $x + 3(20 - 2x) = 30$
$x + 60 - 6x = 30$
$-5x = -30 \implies x = 6$
$y = 20 - 2 \times 6 = 8$

Now, intercepts:
$x=0:\ y=20,15,10$; $y=0:\ x=10,15,30$

Corner points:
$(0,0), (0,10), (5,10), (7.5,7.5), (6,8), (10,0)$

Now check which are feasible for all constraints:
At $y=10,\ x+3\times10=30$→ $x=0$
At $x=5,y=10:\ 2\times5+10=20$; $5+10=15$; $5+3\times10=35>30$ (Not feasible)
At $x=7.5,y=7.5:\ 2\times7.5+7.5=22.5>20$ (Not feasible)
At $x=6,y=8:\2\times6+8=20;6+8=14;6+24=30$
At $x=0,y=10:\2\times0+10=10;0+10=10;0+30=30$
At $x=10,y=0:\ 2\times10=20;10+0=10;10+0=10$

Feasible corner points:
$(0,0), (0,10), (6,8), (10,0)$

Compute $Z$:
$(0,0): 0$
$(0,10): 800$
$(6,8): 50\times6+80\times8=300+640=940$
$(10,0): 500$

Maximum profit at $(6,8)$ is ₹940.

Alternative optimal solution? Check if $Z$ at any other corner equals 940: it does not, so unique solution.

options.A: Produce 0 chairs and 10 tables; maximum profit ₹800; unique solution
options.B: Produce 6 chairs and 8 tables; maximum profit ₹940; unique solution
options.C: Produce 10 chairs and 0 tables; maximum profit ₹500; unique solution
options.D: Produce 5 chairs and 10 tables; maximum profit ₹1050; alternative optimal solution exists
